zh.title: 深圳工厂经理
zh.subtitle: Factory tour in Shenzhen
zh.character: 王经理, production manager at a mid-sized electronics factory in Shenzhen. Proud of the lines, practical, a bit busy.
zh.setting: He is walking Roman through the SMT lines, assembly and the QC room.
zh.goal: Roman asks about production lines, capacity, QC process and defect rates.

zh.title: 硬件供应商
zh.subtitle: Supplier on WeChat voice: price, MOQ, samples
zh.character: 刘总, sales lead at a motor and actuator supplier in Dongguan. Friendly but a tough negotiator.
zh.setting: A WeChat voice call. Roman wants samples and a small first order.
zh.goal: Roman negotiates price, MOQ, samples and lead time. Push back: the MOQ is 1000, samples cost money, lead time is 5 weeks.

zh.title: 机器人创业公司工程师
zh.subtitle: Engineer at a robotics meetup
zh.character: 小陈, a hardware engineer at a Shenzhen robotics startup building robot arms. Curious and nerdy.
zh.setting: Chatting over drinks at a robotics meetup.
zh.goal: Roman explains what ThirdAxis does and what he builds; they swap notes on robots and AI.

zh.title: 商务晚宴
zh.subtitle: Business dinner: toasts and small talk
zh.character: 赵总, the host, owner of a manufacturing company. Warm, proud of the local food, likes to toast.
zh.setting: A round table at a restaurant, dishes keep arriving, baijiu is poured.
zh.goal: Roman handles toasts, small talk about family and travel, compliments the food, and politely refuses more alcohol.

zh.title: 出租车司机
zh.subtitle: Taxi driver: casual, fast, colloquial
zh.character: A chatty Beijing taxi driver. Talks fast, uses a few colloquialisms (挺, 甭, 得嘞, 没事儿), opinionated.
zh.setting: A 20 minute ride across the city in traffic.
zh.goal: Roman gives directions, makes small talk about where he's from and why he's in China.

zh.title: AI研究员
zh.subtitle: AI researcher: Chinese vs US models
zh.character: 林博士, an AI researcher at a Beijing lab. Thoughtful, proud of Chinese open models, friendly.
zh.goal: They compare Chinese and US AI models and labs. Keep it friendly and diplomatic; Roman practises giving careful opinions.

es.title: Ponerse al día
es.subtitle: Catching up with a friend
es.character: Lucía, an old friend Roman hasn't seen in a while. Warm, curious, teases him a bit.
es.goal: Catch up on life, work, travel and plans.

es.title: En el restaurante
es.subtitle: Ordering and small talk
es.character: Diego, a friendly waiter at a busy neighbourhood restaurant.
es.setting: Dinner service. Some dishes are sold out.
es.goal: Roman orders, asks about dishes, handles a sold-out item, makes small talk, asks for the bill.

es.title: En una fiesta
es.subtitle: Explaining your job at a party
es.character: Mariana, a designer Roman just met at a party. Not technical, genuinely interested.
es.goal: Roman explains ThirdAxis, AI agents and his robots to a non-technical person.
